description: Add nullable tenant default tax rate with tenant-qualified restrictive FK and reversible schema migration.
Resolve configured defaults using tenant ownership, active region/rate, and assignment-day eligibility; reject invalid configuration.
Preserve documented unset behavior: catalog NULL and deterministic legacy client fallback without fabricated zero rates.
Expose default settings read/save with billing permissions and preservation of unrelated tenant settings.
Add translated default-rate settings panel with persisted selection, region/percentage labels, and setup/error states.
Prevent rate/region mutations from invalidating a configured default and expose the deletion dependency.
Consolidate shared model and TaxService create/ensure writers behind the transaction-aware shared initializer.
Initialize profile-keyed settings and one client-wide visible default without overwriting existing overrides or location associations.
Make repeated/concurrent initialization idempotent and stop creating or rounding tax components during client creation.
Run required API/model client tax initialization atomically and propagate failures while preserving AlgaDesk/explicit skip behavior.
Keep UI client and Entra provisioning paths on the same shared transactional default policy.
Apply omission-inherits, NULL-non-taxable, UUID-override semantics to server-action catalog creates.
Apply the same creation policy to both ServiceCatalogService and ProductCatalogService with schema preservation of omission.
Give quick-add service/product creates distinct inheritance and non-taxable selections, including reset and late-fetch handling.
Preserve saved tax assignments on product/service edits and all unrelated catalog behavior.
Preview tenant-local NULL catalog rows and permit exclusions before explicitly applying the named saved default.
Apply backfill only to selected still-NULL rows with permission, stale-default, ownership, and rate checks plus changed/skipped counts.
Coordinate assignment/settings/rate lifecycle locks and safe settings upserts under concurrent operations.
Audit supported import/create callers and exports so omission reaches the shared policy without accidental NULL normalization.
Keep invoice region precedence, exemption handling, external tax-source behavior, and existing assignments unchanged.
